第二十三章 智慧就是力量（第1页）
第一宫殿内。罗正站在高台上，身后匍匐着一头通体漆黑、双目幽蓝的巨猫——催乐眠自怪黑猫。
“喵——！”一声诡异的猫叫回荡在大殿中。鹰捷和小青鹰应声倒地，呼呼大睡。
无论怎么推都推不醒。台灵抱着玉兔龙，惊恐地四下张望。
“只剩下一个小丫头，看你还怎么反抗！”黑猫步步逼近。台灵拼命回忆，忽然想起曾经学会吹奏的笛子。
她取出腰间的小笛，放在唇边，用力吹响！尖锐的笛声刺破猫叫的韵律，鹰捷和小青鹰猛地惊醒。
“它的叫声能让人入睡！”台灵喊道，
“用笛声抵消它！”鹰捷心领神会，举起太极统，与台灵配合，一边吹笛一边轰击。
小青鹰振翅干扰，黑猫的叫声再也无法生效。罗正大败而逃，第一把钥匙到手。
第二宫殿内。净神机阴笑着，身旁的魔兽全隐息形白变超色星龙彻底融入环境，无影无踪。
俄莹、雪瞳兽、北辰警惕地四下张望，却什么也看不见。
“咻——！”一道攻击凭空出现，俄莹险险避开。
“它隐身了！”俄莹咬牙。北辰低鸣一声，鹿角骤然亮起璀璨的星光！强光照亮整个大殿，那头魔兽无所遁形——它正趴在天花板上，通体透明，但在强光下轮廓毕现。
“看到了！”俄莹指挥雪瞳兽，莹白光芒笼罩魔兽，北辰冲击，一举将其击溃。
净神机狼狈逃窜，第二把钥匙到手。第三宫殿内。欢喜佛的魔兽白铁黑甲黄甲星虫防御力惊人，螃惊蟹邪的剪刀剪不动，因缘兽的铁棒砸不伤，明玥的定海神针也无可奈何。
“这家伙太难缠了！”星璃急道。莉亚·塞莱娜仔细观察，忽然眼睛一亮：“它怕水！”
“因缘兽，水攻！”因缘兽张口喷出巨浪，白铁黑甲黄甲星虫浑身一颤，甲壳上竟出现裂纹——原来它长期生活在干燥环境，最怕水浸。
螃惊蟹邪趁机一剪，咔嚓！甲壳碎裂。欢喜佛败退，第三把钥匙到手。

第四宫殿内。台焕面对父亲，却迟迟无法出手。
“焕儿，你还是那么软弱。”台振岳冷冷道。台焕咬牙，脑中忽然闪过父亲从前的教诲：“无论面对什么，都要坚守正义。”他深吸一口气，握紧道晶剑。
“父亲，我不会逃避。”真正的较量，即将开始。

Chapter 23 Wisdom is power (page 1)
Inside the first palace. Luo Zheng was standing on a high platform, and behind him was a giant cat with pitch black body and blue eyes - the black cat that blamed Le Mian.
"Meow——!" A strange cat meow echoed in the hall. Yingjie and Xiao Qingying fell to the ground and fell into a deep sleep.
No matter how hard I push, I can't wake him up. Tai Ling held the Jade Rabbit Dragon and looked around in horror.
"There's only one little girl left, let's see how you resist!" The black cat approached step by step. Tai Ling tried his best to remember, and suddenly remembered the flute he had learned to play.
She took out the small flute from her waist, put it to her lips, and played it hard! The sharp flute sound pierced the rhythm of the cat's meow, and Ying Jie and Xiao Qingying suddenly woke up.
"Its cry can make people fall asleep!" Tai Ling shouted,
"Use the sound of the flute to counteract it!" Ying Jie understood, raised the Tai Chi System, and cooperated with the Tai Ling, playing the flute and bombarding at the same time.
The little green eagle flapped its wings and interfered, and the black cat's cry no longer had any effect. Luo Zheng fled in defeat and got the first key.
Inside the Second Palace. Jingshenji smiled sinisterly, and the monster beside him became completely invisible and transformed into a white and super-colored star dragon, completely blending into the environment without a trace.
Oying, Snow Eye Beast, and Beichen looked around vigilantly, but could not see anything.
"Wha—!" An attack appeared out of thin air, but Erying narrowly avoided it.
"It's invisible!" Oying gritted her teeth. Beichen let out a low cry, and the antlers suddenly lit up with bright starlight! The strong light illuminated the entire hall, and the monster was nowhere to be seen - it was lying on the ceiling, completely transparent, but its outline was clearly visible under the strong light.
"I saw it!" Erying commanded the Snow-Eyed Beast, and the white light enveloped the monster. Beichen attacked and defeated it in one fell swoop.
Jingshenji fled in panic and got the second key. Inside the third palace. The defensive power of Huanxi Buddha's white iron, black-armored and yellow-armored star insect is astonishing. Crab Jingxie's scissors cannot cut it, Karma Beast's iron rod cannot damage it, and Mingyue's Dinghai Shenzhen can't do anything.
"This guy is too difficult to deal with!" Xingli said anxiously. Leah Selena observed carefully, and suddenly her eyes lit up: "It is afraid of water!"
"Karma Beast, water attack!" Karma Beast opened its mouth and spat out a huge wave. The white iron, black and yellow armored starworm trembled, and cracks appeared on its carapace - it turned out that it had lived in a dry environment for a long time and was most afraid of flooding.
Crab Jing Xie took the opportunity to cut, click! The carapace shattered. Happy Buddha retreated and got the third key.
In the fourth palace. Tai Huan faced his father, but was unable to take action.
"Huan'er, you are still so weak." Tai Zhenyue said coldly. Tai Huan gritted his teeth, and his father's previous teachings suddenly flashed through his mind: "No matter what you face, you must stick to justice." He took a deep breath and tightened his grip on the Dao Crystal Sword.
"Father, I will not run away." The real battle is about to begin.
